testcase.name: Scenario: Apply and remove a custom ribbon panel: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:59:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply and remove a custom ribbon panel ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog has an empty custom panel for "Part | 3D Model" ✔ And the command category is "Sketch Tab" ✔ When the user adds "Circle (Center Point)" and a separator to the custom panel list ✔ Then the custom panel list contains the circle command followed by a separator ✔ And the separator remains available in the source list ✔ When the user clicks "Apply" ✔ Then the customization dialog remains open ✔ And the target selector no longer indicates a pending change ✔ And the "User Commands" panel appears on the active ribbon ✔ When the user removes the separator and the circle command from the custom panel list ✔ And the user clicks "Apply" ✔ Then the custom panel list is empty ✔ And the "User Commands" panel is no longer visible on the active ribbon
